title: Tree-first with vision escalation — the experiment program
status: OPEN — research phase; no product change, no default flip, no prompt bump
question: With the accessibility tree as the default actor, when must vision be invoked, which vision mode is the most efficient one (fastest to a CORRECT resolution, not least spend), and does the resulting policy beat both pure-tree and pure-vision on correctness-weighted time-to-completion?
objective: Maximise the rate of correct completions; then minimise median and p90 time-to-correct-completion, subject to correctness >= the pure-vision arm. Mode choice per class = lowest expected time-to-correct-resolution (ETCR), not lowest spend.
efficiencyMetric: ETCR = P(correct)*latency_correct + P(incorrect)*(latency_incorrect + recovery_cost) + P(no progress)*fallback_cost. Lower is better. Advancement alone is NOT correctness: a wrong-but-moving action that needs a recovery counts as incorrect.

hypotheses.H1: The tree path is materially faster per action (1-2 text-only calls vs 2-4 image-carrying calls).
hypotheses.H2: Tree failures are classifiable from observable state (the existing failure seams), not random.
hypotheses.H3: Most tree failures are repairable by a partial vision mode (verify/ground/propose) more efficiently than by a full step - a hypothesis, not a cost rule: a partial mode can lose on ETCR when it is ambiguous, wrong, or needs retries.
hypotheses.H4: Early escalation reduces end-to-end time-to-correct-completion even though escalated steps are slower (failed tree runs are the slowest observed outcome: 358-648 s vs 25-82 s successes).

corpus.R1: open verkkokauppa.com and add two cases of lemon lime celsius energy drink to the shopping cart (the safe benchmark; vision report in runs 13/14)
corpus.R2: find the wwe channel on rumble.com and press the latest video in Live tab
corpus.R3: buy SoundMagic E11C with delivery to koivuviita 7 B 5. Total budget including delivery: 60 euros
corpus.R4: open youtube.com and switch the active user channel to MrAwesome. Then find the Food Wishes channel from my subscriptions and play the latest posted video
corpus.rules: R3 keeps its goal text unchanged. The ORCHESTRATING AGENT monitors the run via navcap and stops it at the first screenshot showing a credit-card input screen, using the experiment-only EXPERIMENT_STOP_TASK broadcast (the same onStopTask/TaskCancelFlag path as the stop control, terminal USER_CANCEL). A monitor stop is NOT a failure: correctness is judged at the stop point and the run is recorded stop_reason=MONITOR_CARD_STOP. Per-run resets are binding (R1/R3 cart empty; R4 active channel reset to the starting account); a run with a failed reset is discarded. Correctness anchors are per goal and a GOAL_ACHIEVED that misses its anchor counts as a false completion.

stages.0-observability: PENDING — RunResult persistence + ExperimentProbe no-op seam + sampled frames + steps.csv/runs.csv
stages.1-tree-taxonomy: PENDING — real corpus (R1-R6) + synthetic probes (S1-S8); every failure class >=3 instances or marked unobserved
stages.2-shadow-vision: PENDING — shadow consult at 100% non-HIGH + 20% HIGH control; rescue potential per class
stages.3-rescue-on-failure: PENDING — BLOCKED->vision handoff at EMPTY_SLATE / NO_GOOD_TARGET / NO_PROGRESS; paired vs tree-only
stages.4-rule-and-ABC: PENDING — derived decision table; interleaved T/H/V on the full corpus
stages.5-recommendation: PENDING — recommendation.md with the data table, risks, and the road decision

exitCriteria: Stage 0 evidence exists for both engines; suites green with the probe unarmed
Every failure class observed >=3x or marked unobserved
Most efficient vision mode identified per class by measured ETCR, with sample size and confidence
A candidate policy with measured coverage and precision
A/B/C: hybrid correct-completion rate >= pure-vision and hybrid time-to-correct-completion < pure-vision
stopRule: Stage 5 reached and the owner decided, OR two consecutive iterations with no new failure class and no decision-table change, OR the owner calls it.
nextAction: Stage 0: implement WI1-WI3 on exp/tree-first, then run the iteration-1 warm-up (one tree-only BBC run + one vision run) and write .state/vision-iter/vexp9/iteration-1.md.
masterPolicy: master receives no experiment code. If the recommendation is accepted, the change is written as its own phase doc and implemented on master.
